name: access-tab
js: state.music.mute = true; Object.assign(state.access, { allArrows: true, showPath: false, showSolids: true }); const i = TABS.findIndex(t => t[1] === "access"); document.querySelectorAll("#tabs button")[i].click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); window.__report = { rows: [...document.querySelectorAll("#panel .accbox")].map(b => Math.round(b.getBoundingClientRect().height)) };

name: boxes-beach
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world.at = null; Object.assign(state.access, { showSolids: true, boxColor: "#ffffff" }); Object.assign(state.background, { kind: "beach", figX: 0, figY: 60 }); Object.assign(state.body, { facing: "front", anim: "none" }); changed(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 900)); window.__report = { k: +figureT.k.toFixed(3), solids: solidsHere().map(o => [o.name, Math.round(o.x0), Math.round(o.x1), Math.round(o.h), o.bands ? o.bands.map(b => [Math.round(b.x0), Math.round(b.x1), Math.round(b.lo), Math.round(b.hi)]) : null]) };
